How we work

A few rules we follow

  • Keep it simple

    Fewer screens, clear navigation, no clutter.

  • Only claim what works

    We describe a feature after it has been built and tested.

  • You stay in control

    You should be able to see and manage your account, data and settings.

  • Use compute carefully

    We prefer smaller, efficient systems where they do the job.
